description: What is left of the caller's own allowance - bank lookups, IBAN validations and OCR extractions counted separately - with the plan name and the dates the current period runs between. The only tool here that reports on the account rather than on an IBAN. Worth calling before a long run of lookups, and after analyze_iban or validate_iban refuses one, to tell a spent allowance apart from a bad request. Requires an X-Api-Key header but costs no allowance; the figures are a snapshot that the next metered call moves.
name: get_allowance
title: Allowance remaining
